messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: [irace-package] Irace for Multiobjective Optimization
parts:
On 06/11/16 12:22, Nada wrote:
> I want to set irace for multi objective problem, but I still have this error.

Hi Nada,

Have you read Section 10.2 in the user guide? I would suggest to try first to
set-up the MOACO example mentioned there. You need to download and compile the
hypervolume and MOACO codes separately. The instructions come with the irace
package (inst/examples/moaco). Unfortunately, we have only tested this example
in GNU/Linux (but it should work in OSX as well).

Once you get that working, it should be obvious how to tune your own
multi-objective optimizer, even when using a different quality metric. If your
algorithm computes the quality metric itself, the target-runner would be even
simpler.

> == irace == The output was:
> 12:07:12 UTC 2016: error: c1-1.stdout: No such file or directory
> == irace == This is not a bug in irace, but means that something failed when
> running the command(s) above or they were terminated before completion. Try to
> run the command(s) above from the execution directory '/home/monpc/MULTIDSM' to
> investigate the issue.

> Execution halted/
>
>
> How can I solve it?//

Many things may be causing that output and they are often some problem in
target-runner/target-evaluator. It is difficult to say more without knowing
what your target-runner/target-evaluator are doing exactly. Appendix B in the
user-guide may help to pin-point the problem.

Cheers,

Manuel.
